# Keybinds

These are the defaults the pack ships. Default Options applies them on **first launch only**, so if you have played before, your own `options.txt` wins and these are just a reference.

89 bound actions. Anything not listed is deliberately unbound to stop two mods fighting over one key — rebind them yourself in Options → Controls.
